p: Matlock Bath is a small village with a big personality, and the Heights of Abraham is just one part of a cracking day out here. The cable cars cross the River Derwent and the main road below, and from the top you can pick out the village, the gorge and Riber Castle on the hill across the valley.

For more family fun, Gulliver's Kingdom is a theme park aimed at younger children right here in Matlock Bath, and the Peak District Lead Mining Museum on the main street tells the story of the industry that shaped these hills. It pairs brilliantly with the caverns at the top of the hill.

Just down the road, Cromford is home to Richard Arkwright's mills, part of the Derwent Valley Mills World Heritage Site and a fascinating look at the birth of the factory system. Masson Mill sits between the two villages too.
In autumn, the village is known for its illuminations, when the river and promenade light up with colourful displays, so it's worth checking dates if you fancy an evening visit.
Pack sturdy shoes and a light layer, because it's cooler underground than you might expect.
